hypothesis: Training the frozen E005 recipe on all 81 usable public real trajectories and packaging it with the frozen E008 interval (0.025, 0.15) and singleton micro-batch wrapper will pass every E008-style local submission gate.
comparator: E008 package/contract/runtime gates; no leakage-safe public holdout remains for quality comparison

data.normalization: train-only Gaussian statistics over all 81 usable public real trajectories

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping

public_contract_windows.purpose: contract testing only; not model selection evidence

local_gpu_whole_run_proxy.construction: cycle the two public contract windows; no additional field data
local_gpu_whole_run_proxy.interpretation: supplementary RTX 5050/Torch 2.7.1 evidence for the A800/Torch 2.2.2 limit

controls: Training recipe is unchanged from E005 except the file set is all 81 usable public real trajectories
Interval remains the frozen E006/E008/E009 values; it is not re-selected
E002 and complementary-fold scores are not computed or used for selection
Codabench scores are not used for parameter selection
decision_rule: Promote and retain the archive only if every E008-style package, official-container, bounds, determinism, scorer, and runtime gate passes. Do not treat public-example scores as quality evidence.
promotion: submission candidate only if the local gate passes; E008 remains the frozen leaderboard baseline until a new Codabench result is recorded
limitations: There is no leakage-safe local holdout after training on all public real files.
Fewer effective epochs than E005 at the same 600-update budget because the window count is larger.
Local RTX 5050/Torch 2.7.1 timing is not the official A800/Torch 2.2.2 measurement.
